bibl.title: An Invocation on an Obsidian Gem with Hermeneutical Glosses.
bibl.seg: Roy Kotansky, An Invocation on an Obsidian Gem with Hermeneutical Glosses.
bibl.note: An unusual magic gem carved on obsidian preserves on its bevelled edge a Greek invocation to an otherwise unidentified 'lofty-throned' Creator God, asking to provide health and salvation for its wearer and to check every evil and malevolent demonic force. - Private collection. Unknown provenance (Egypt?), 2nd cent. CE.
